name: 60610 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60610 (Chicago) has 272 nonprofit organizations. 115 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60610 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60610 (Chicago) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 73 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
